_comment: Bump binary_version whenever a change requires a NEW APK/EXE rather than a content-only update: Godot engine version, export template, permissions, native plugins, icons, or anything outside res:// content. Everything else ships as a content pack. version_name is cosmetic in the app, but it goes into the release tag: ASCII letters, digits, ., _ and - only (ci/prepare_build.sh refuses anything else).
